card-slots.note: the MX480 front photograph, re-read for #261: the body runs x px 35-1466 = 443 mm, 3.230 px/mm across (an SFF-8433 ganged-SFP pitch of 46.05 px cross-checks 3.232), and 1139 px = 355.6 mm down, 3.203 - isotropic to 0.8%, NOT the 5.1% the scale note used to state, which took the ear-inclusive 1500 px as the body. The card plates run x px 155-1435 = 396.3 mm, chassis x 37.15-433.4. Each slot is the 413.5 x 29.5 lever envelope of the card, centred on the measured plate at x 28.5-442.0, with `opening` 396.0 x 29.5 - the plate, not the levers, which stand proud of the face and read less reliably. SLOT PITCH 31.3, MEASURED AS A RANGE: the eight slots span 808 px between the outer gaps, 101.0 px each, which is 31.27 mm at the across scale and 31.53 at the down scale; x is the better-anchored axis (two independent rulers agree on it), so 31.3, with 31.2-31.5 the honest range. Centred on the photograph's own cage centre, chassis y 216.5. Until 3.0.0 the slots were 420.9 wide at x 11.5 on a 31.86 pitch.

chassis.note: datasheet-table - guide chassis description: 14.0 x 17.45 x 24.5 in (355.6 x 443 x 622 mm), 8RU. Ears are NOT MODELLED by project convention

front-rows.note: photo - vent band 0-38.6, craft 38.6-80.6, card cage 92.2-340.8 as eight 31.3 mm slots, top to bottom DPC 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, then SCB 1 and SCB 0 (craft tabs: blue 0/1 for SCBs, white 0-5 for DPCs; the slot-number tabs match). The slot-number tab strip runs x 12.1-34.4 and the card plates x 37.25-433.25 (card-slots, slot-tabs)

ground-stud-pitch.note: the hardware guide, chassis grounding points specifications: 0.625-in. (15.86-mm) centres, which is 5/8 in., 15.875; the guide rounds the conversion. `ground-studs` is one placement of juniper/mx-ground-stud-pair-5-8@1, which composes juniper/mx-ground-stud@1 twice at exactly 15.875 (L116) and presents `stud-pair-5-8`, so one two-hole lug (generic/two-hole-lug-5-8@1) lands across the pair and the ring lug still lands on either stud, `ground-studs/1` and `/2`. The two studs were drawn 13.2 apart; they moved symmetrically about the midpoint the photograph placed, (426.7, 28.8), the MX240's (gaps.rear-ground-and-esd), one stud above the other, so the host is placed at `rotate: 90` and a lug's wire leaves downward, and their cutouts with them.

ground-stud-size.note: the hardware guide, chassis grounding points specifications: two threaded inserts (PEM nuts) that fit UNC 1/4-20 screws, spaced at 0.625 in. (15.86 mm) centres, for one two-hole cable lug: the `stud-size` of both studs.

other-faces.note: near-blank by evidence - rail bands and the right-side exhaust field estimated as on the MX240. Axis conventions per viewer3d.js: LEFT x = 0 REAR, RIGHT x = 0 FRONT, top/bottom y = 0 FRONT

populated-with.note: photo - slot 4 carries DPC 4x10GE (the DPC-R-4XGE-XFP face), slots 3 and 0 carry DPC 40xGE (DPCE-R-40GE-SFP, with transceivers seated in the photo - drawn as empty cages), slots 5/2/1 carry blank covers, SCB 1 carries SCB-MX with RE-S-2000 and SCB 0 with RE-S-1300. Defaults reproduce that configuration except both SCBs default to the RE-S-1300 (the SCB contract carries one default; RE-S-2000 is in accepts and the photo difference is recorded here)

power.note: guide power tables - base system 40 W, cooling 110/160 W normal/high (Table 91, dedicated tap), SCB and card figures on the shared components. The guide gives no chassis total and instructs a per-configuration budget; the MX Series family datasheet does give one, typical power draw 3470 W AC and 3150 W DC, with no configuration, ambient or side named - carried as power-typical-w (AC) with the DC figure in power-typical-scope, envelope unstated. Table 95 is a worked sample by DC zone (1090 W zone 0, 850 W zone 1) and is not carried. Table 89 states maximum thermal output AC 11,322 BTU/hour (3,318 W) and DC 9,632 BTU/hour (2,823 W) and marks the figures as estimates - carried under thermal as a provisioning ceiling

rear.note: photo - four PSU bays across the top on a 103.9 mm pitch (dividers measured at 110.8/214.7/318.2), AC supplies photographed; the vertical air-filter (left) and fan-tray (right) door strips below, estimated at 12 x 240; earthing studs and ESD placed at the MX240's positions and marked estimated - the AC rear photo does not resolve them

scale.note: photo - the rear photograph passes the orthographic gate at 0.8% (3.33 px/mm isotropic). The front photograph is isotropic to 0.8% (x 3.230 px/mm over the 443 mm body, px 35-1466; y 3.203 to 355.6). Until 3.0.0 this note called it 5.1% anisotropic, anchored at x 3.379 px/mm: that took the ear-inclusive 1500 px as the body, so the front's x positions placed before 3.0.0 (the vent band, the ESD point) are compressed about 4.5%; the card slots were re-placed at 3.0.0 (card-slots), the rest awaits its own pass. Feature sizes come from the registry and the shared card family

slot-tabs.note: the MX480 front photograph: a grey strip, x px 74-146 = chassis x 12.1-34.4, carries a slot-number tab beside each slot (x 17.0-28.0), white for the DPC/MPC slots and blue for SCB 1 and SCB 0. The slot numbers are printed on those tabs, at x 22.8; until 3.0.0 they were drawn at x 5.6 on the dark side rail.
